implementation.form: Opt-in LD_PRELOAD CPU graph and native buffer-release interposer; matching native CPU plugin is reused.
implementation.source_discovery: Bounded native original-projection descriptors learned from CPU MUL_MAT_ID nodes; no extra model copy.
implementation.trigger: Current exact pre-admission router IDs/slot map at native CPU dispatcher entry.
implementation.warming: Read one byte per64-byte cacheline, bounded gate/up/down prefix, original per-rank order.
implementation.queue: At most one pending job and one active reader, latest-only replacement.
implementation.deadline: Cancel at any CPU expert graph entry; check generation and wall budget between<=64KiB chunks. Not hard real time.
implementation.buffer_release: Cancel and drain outstanding readers before original owner-buffer release.
implementation.mmap_lifetime_verified: Pinned llama_model::impl declares mappings before ctxs_bufs; reverse member destruction releases owner buffers before unmapping.
implementation.read_snapshot: Completed chunks sampled at next CPU expert entry, classified by actual native cold IDs versus newly GPU-admitted IDs.
implementation.missing_first_use_sources: Explicit skip counter; one initial source miss per matched process, not silently labeled warm.

configuration.wait_policy: Native fastest OpenMP behavior; no GOMP override.
configuration.helper_core_note: Logical16 shares physicalcore0, not extra physical compute capacity.
configuration.affinity_scope: One32MiB CCD,16 logicalCPUs so16 batch threads remain valid. Both baseline and candidate share this mask.

matched_request_results.confidence_note: Three triplets, no confidence interval; small subpercent deltas are not a precise universal regression.
matched_request_results.cohort: native-libs-*; no research GGML base in any runtime mapping

work_accounting.scope: Includes any scalar warmup/prefill as well as generation. Logical cacheline payload, not physical DRAM traffic or cache hits.

measurement.limitation: NVTX job intervals include checks/no-read cancellations, not per-cacheline timestamps. Whole process includes any scalar warmup/prefill. Categories overlap. Instrumented run excluded from performance matrix.
measurement.algorithm: Union interval labels with cache-window helper and intersect process-scoped CUDA and CPU ranges.

actual_cuda_overlap.conclusion: Most helper activity is not inside GPU compute; trigger precedes GPU expert launch and much work overlaps CPU dispatcher/control or host gaps.

unrestricted_coding_screen.scope: Native process affinity, helper fixed16; no CCD locality guarantee. Not a repeated affinity optimization study.

comparisons.scope: Exact installed library set; original long held-out corpus.

validation.fixtures: Three model unload/reload rounds, native output bits, no-op/zero/expiry, queued immediate release, bad config, GPU-admission snapshot accounting.

asan_ubsan.scope: Fixture/helper instrumented, exact installed native CPU/base reused uninstrumented.

validation.sanitizer_scope: Fixture and helper only; native plugins uninstrumented, leak detectionoff, no TSAN claim.
validation.driver_timeout: Own process group terminated on timeout; tested without touching external processes.
validation.model_loader_guard_retained: Initial8-logicalCPU/16batch-thread request rejected safely, not fixed by loosening app limits.

decision.next_gate: A different early-hint or execution-order mechanism must demonstrate real GPU overlap and matched request gains; merely increasing read volume did not win.

limitations: One host/model; pinned singleCCD main matrix is not a universal placement recommendation.
No active GPU-query gate; this tests a causal dispatch-triggered cache warmer, not an oracle predictor or persistent GPU scheduler.
Counter chunks completed before sampled cancellation are not guaranteed retained/useful cachelines.
Current hints can include experts subsequently admitted to GPU; wasted read snapshots remain charged.
No concurrent-request qualification, no energy measurement and no general model-quality claim.
Original weight SHA identity is historical evidence; this study did not rehash all59GiB.

tooling.provenance_note: Clean cohort uses installed base/CPU/backend paths attested identically. Older ABI-compatible research-base runs are retained but excluded; earlier source/binary hashes are never relabeled.

retained_setup_failure.reason: Batch threads16 exceed available logicalCPU count8; rejected before model launch. Subsequent postprocessor also attempted to index the empty failed sample list; not a numerical failure.

audit.reason: Preload RUNPATH pulled research GGML base into candidate; native no-preload used installed base. Library hashes differ.
